business_problem: Proaction needed a way to create highly personalized fleet-management demos and operational follow-ups without consuming scarce engineering time, while also extending automation into day-to-day fleet workflows for customers.
solution_summary: Proaction turned Codex into the working surface for sales, product, and support operations. After a call, the team feeds Codex the Granola meeting recording, prospect email threads, and shared spreadsheets so it can build an HTML demo environment that mirrors Proaction's product and the prospect's actual fleet. Those demos then double as implementation references once a deal closes, reducing back-and-forth with engineers. Codex plugins connect Gmail, Slack, Linear, GitHub, and HubSpot so follow-ups, issue creation, and sales updates happen in one place. On the customer side, Proaction is extending the same model stack into its Managed Execution Layer, where GPT-Live-1, GPT-6 Astra, and ChatGPT-5.6 Sol support voice agents such as Marty that coordinate maintenance, review documents and images, and help execute fleet operations with humans stepping in only when exceptions require judgment.

solution_components.name: Granola

solution_components.name: GPT-Live-1

solution_components.name: GPT-6 Astra
solution_components.role: Accelerates the creation of customer experiences and computer-use flows for Proaction's agents.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT-5.6 Sol
solution_components.role: Helps identify vehicle damage from submitted photos and supports platform analysis tasks.

solution_components.name: Marty

data_flow: Sales context from Granola, email threads, and spreadsheets flows into Codex, which creates a prospect-specific HTML demo and writes updates into connected business systems. For customer operations, voice, document, image, and chat inputs route through GPT-Live-1, GPT-6 Astra, and ChatGPT-5.6 Sol so agents such as Marty can coordinate maintenance and other fleet workflows before escalating exceptions to humans.
business_outcome: Proaction increased sales by 60%, saved 40-60 engineering hours a month on custom demos, saved founders 25-33 hours a month on cross-tool work, and began extending voice agents into fleet operations so customers reclaim time as well.
